# DSContainer

> DSContainer is a free, native iPhone app for managing Docker containers and Compose projects on a Synology NAS through Synology Container Manager. It talks directly to the NAS over the DSM Web API, with no cloud service, account, telemetry, or ads.

- Price: free
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26 or later
- Requires: Synology NAS on DSM 7 with Container Manager installed
- Source code: open source on GitHub

## Features

- Start, stop, restart, pause, and unpause containers
- Read container logs next to live CPU and memory charts
- Inspect a container's ports, volumes, and environment variables
- Bring whole Compose projects (stacks) up or down
- System monitor with rolling CPU, memory, and network history for the NAS
- Background health checks that send a push notification when a container stops
- Multiple saved NAS connections; sessions are restored on launch, so two-factor sign-in is not needed every time
- Supports HTTPS, two-factor authentication, and self-signed certificates
- Credentials and sessions are stored in the iOS Keychain and never leave the device
